CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to the identified content was stated.

COD.rationale: Multiple entries pair identified content (referent + color positions) with explicit organization (position lists) and separate origin/status fields for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit statement links an attention/allocation condition to the organization/presentation/access of the same identified content.

C.rationale: The report lists identified contents (grid referents) with explicit attributes (red/blue) and coordinate sets.

D.rationale: Origins/status fields (e.g. copied_prior_record, history_estimate, executed_branch_claim:false) separately mark content source/status distinct from the content coordinates.

O.rationale: The report specifies how contents are presented as organized coordinate sets for current and candidate (future) representations.
